name: immunodeficiency due to selective anti-polysaccharide antibody deficiency
description: Immunodeficiency due to selective anti-polysaccharide antibody deficiency is characterized by normal immunoglobulin levels (including IgG sub-classes) but impaired polysaccharide responsiveness (IPR).
